howItWorks.journeyTitle: Choose the workflow that matches your role
howItWorks.journeyBody: Buildink adapts discovery, publishing, collaboration and operations tools to the account type you use.

projectOwner.label: Project owner
projectOwner.summary: Publish projects and tenders, review bids, manage awarded work and keep delivery visible.

company.label: Company
company.summary: Build a trusted company profile, manage your team, respond to opportunities and coordinate active work.

subcontractor.label: Subcontractor
subcontractor.summary: Find relevant packages, submit offers, exchange documents and move accepted work into delivery.

serviceProvider.label: Service provider
serviceProvider.summary: Show specialist services, receive qualified requests and manage conversations from one workspace.

worker.label: Worker
worker.summary: Create a professional profile, apply to opportunities and access assigned workforce workflows.

howItWorks.stepsBody: Each stage is connected, so users can move from public discovery into a permission-aware private workflow without losing context.

steps.step1Body: Register with the correct account type and complete the profile or company workspace that represents you.
steps.step2Body: Add the required profile, company and verification evidence before relying on trust badges or publication status.
steps.step3Body: Search companies, workers, projects, tenders and requests, or publish opportunities when your permissions allow it.
steps.step4Body: Send offers or applications, compare responses, review evidence and apply the correct approval workflow.
steps.step5Body: Use protected messages, notifications, documents and role-aware workspace access throughout the engagement.
steps.step6Body: Move accepted work into project, workforce, attendance, task, compliance and operational tracking flows.

howItWorks.featuresBody: These are the primary product capabilities connected by the Website and portal experience.

features.feature1Body: Search and filter public companies, profiles, equipment, projects, tenders and opportunities.
features.feature2Body: Navigation and actions change according to account type, membership, capability and permission.
features.feature3Body: Submit, review, shortlist, revise, accept or reject commercial and workforce responses.
features.feature4Body: Keep trust status tied to submitted evidence and reviewed verification requirements.
features.feature5Body: Keep important marketplace and workspace activity visible without exposing private contact details too early.
features.feature6Body: Track project delivery, workforce activity, tasks, attendance, costs, alerts and compliance records.

verification.statusBody: A trust badge is only useful when the underlying evidence and review state support it.

statuses.pendingBody: Evidence has not completed review yet. Public claims should remain limited.
statuses.reviewBody: Required documents or checks are being assessed by the verification workflow.
statuses.verifiedBody: The published verification scope has been satisfied and approved.

verification.processBody: Identity, company and supporting documents should stay aligned with the account and publication state.

about.principlesBody: A construction marketplace needs more than listings. It needs identity, permissions, trust signals and a clear path into real work.

principles.oneBody: Verification and publication states should reflect evidence rather than optimistic labels.
principles.twoBody: Project owners, companies, subcontractors, service providers and workers should see the workflows that fit them.
principles.threeBody: Discovery, offers, messaging, documents and operations should connect without dead ends.

contact.optionsBody: Use the contact form for product, account, marketplace or launch questions. Include enough context for the team to route the request correctly.
contact.supportBody: For account access, workspace behavior, verification or marketplace issues, describe the affected flow and the page you were using.
contact.businessBody: For partnerships, marketplace participation and company onboarding, tell us what your organization needs from Buildink.
contact.safetyBody: For incorrect public information, verification concerns or unsafe content, use the relevant reporting or verification channel.

cookies.preferencesBody: Essential cookies keep authentication, security and core navigation working. Optional categories can be changed here at any time.
cookies.essentialBody: Required for security, authentication and core product behavior.
cookies.preferencesCategoryBody: Remembers interface and experience choices where available.
cookies.analyticsBody: Helps measure product usage and performance when enabled.
cookies.marketingBody: Allows optional marketing measurement where it is configured.

footer.title: Discover trusted people, companies and opportunities — then keep the work moving.
footer.body: Buildink connects public discovery with verification, protected collaboration and role-aware workspaces.
